description: This Kotlin source file manages image processing for a chat application. It handles loading, decoding, scaling, encoding, and caching of image attachments, specifically for images in chat messages. Functions include loading sized images, decoding base64 strings into Bitmaps, computing sample sizes for efficient decoding, normalizing filenames, and decoding/scaling Bitmaps from a ContentResolver.

classes.name: LruCache
classes.description: An in-memory cache for Bitmap objects with a maximum size, implementing an LRU eviction policy.

methods.name: loadSizedImageAttachment
methods.description: Loads and scales an image from a URI to fit within maximum dimensions, encodes it as JPEG, and returns a PendingImageAttachment with base64 data.

methods.name: decodeBase64Bitmap
methods.description: Decodes a base64 string into a Bitmap, utilizing a cache for performance, and scales the image to a maximum dimension.

methods.name: computeInSampleSize
methods.description: Calculates the appropriate inSampleSize for BitmapFactory decoding to efficiently load large images within a max dimension.

methods.name: normalizeAttachmentFileName
methods.description: Sanitizes and normalizes filename strings for image attachments, defaulting to 'image.jpg' if input is empty.
